methodology: Cross-platform user interaction audit: SuperAdmin → POS App, SuperAdmin → Supplier Portal, SuperAdmin → Retailer Admin. Traced every SA action that cascades to other platforms. Verified backend cascade chains, notification gaps, and race conditions between concurrent operations.

critical_findings.title: Store Suspension Does Not Immediately Revoke Active POS Sessions
critical_findings.description: SA suspends store → POS polls ui-status every 60s. During lag, staff continues checkout. No session revocation, no forced logout, no transaction rollback.

critical_findings.title: Device Token Reset Does Not Force Re-enrollment; Offline Device Continues Operating
critical_findings.description: SA resets device token → device_token = NULL in DB. Online device gets 401 but falls back to safe defaults. Offline device never learns about revocation, completes transactions offline.

critical_findings.title: Staff Role Changes Not Propagated to Active POS Sessions
critical_findings.description: SA changes staff role (CASHIER→MANAGER or vice versa). POS staffSessionStore caches role at login. Authorization checks use stale role until next logout/login.

critical_findings.title: Suspended Supplier Products Still Visible in POS/Retailer Catalogs
critical_findings.description: SA suspends supplier → verification_status=SUSPENDED. But catalog queries filter on s.status='ACTIVE' (different column). Products remain visible, orderable.

critical_findings.title: Store Suspension Not Detected by Retailer Admin Portal
critical_findings.description: SA suspends store → retailer admin portal has NO mechanism to check store status. AuthContext only reads user auth state, not store status. Retailer continues operating.

critical_findings.title: User Status Changes Not Synchronized to Retailer Sessions
critical_findings.description: SA suspends user → auth.users.status=suspended. But retailer session remains active. No middleware check on user.status before allowing requests. Session persists until token expiry (24h).

critical_findings.title: Store Suspension Does Not Invalidate POS Device Tokens
critical_findings.description: transitionStore() in storeStateMachine.ts only updates store status. No cascade to pos_devices table. No device token revocation. No FCM notification.

critical_findings.title: Store Deletion Does Not Cascade to Devices or Related Tables
critical_findings.description: DELETE /stores/:storeId updates status='deleted' but does NOT deactivate devices, revoke tokens, or mark enrollment codes as revoked. Orphaned devices remain active.

critical_findings.title: Store Suspension Has NO Notification to Store Owner
critical_findings.description: SA suspends store → zero notifications sent. Owner discovers only when POS fails or portal access blocked. No email/SMS/WhatsApp.

critical_findings.title: Supplier Suspension Has NO Notification to Supplier
critical_findings.description: SA suspends supplier → supplier status silently changes. No notification sent. Supplier unaware until next login attempt.

critical_findings.title: Store Suspension During Payment — Cache TTL Creates 30s Window
critical_findings.description: storeStatusGate.ts caches store status with 30s TTL. If SA suspends store during cache window, POS can complete payment for suspended store. Ledger integrity violated.

critical_findings.title: Store Status Cache Invalidation Gap
critical_findings.description: No cache invalidation mechanism when store status changes. 30s window where POS sees stale ACTIVE status. Multiple concurrent requests see inconsistent state.

critical_findings.title: Sale Confirm + Invoice Void Ledger Conflict
critical_findings.description: POS confirms payment (locks sale row FOR UPDATE) while SA voids invoice in parallel. No distributed lock. Double-entry ledger broken: debit recorded but invoice cancelled.

high_findings.title: Deactivated Staff Can Complete In-Progress Transactions
high_findings.description: SA deactivates staff → POS session remains valid (stored locally). No per-transaction staff status check. Staff completes current transaction.

high_findings.title: Feature Flag Changes Have 60s Latency; Checkout Can Use Disabled Flag
high_findings.description: SA toggles flag → POS polls every 60s. During lag, customer can checkout with disabled flag.

high_findings.title: Device Hardware Config Changes Not Detected During Active Use
high_findings.description: SA changes printing mode → POS caches at startup. No real-time printer config polling.

high_findings.title: Supplier Session Not Revoked on Suspension
high_findings.description: SA suspends supplier → tokens_revoked_at set but supplier portal auth doesn't check. Session valid until JWT expiry (24h).

high_findings.title: Supplier Application Rejection Not Notified
high_findings.description: SA rejects application → no WhatsApp/email sent. Supplier discovers rejection only on next login.

high_findings.title: Supplier Bank Detail Rejection Not Cascaded to Payments
high_findings.description: SA rejects bank account → bank_verification_status=rejected but payout flow doesn't check. Supplier unaware.

high_findings.title: Device Deactivation by SA Has No Effect on Retailer Portal
high_findings.description: SA deactivates device → retailer admin has no device management UI. No status indication.

high_findings.title: Product Rejection Not Cascaded to Retailer Orders
high_findings.description: SA rejects product → existing retailer POs with that product NOT updated. ReorderPage doesn't check approval status.

high_findings.title: Suspended Store Device Tokens Still Active
high_findings.description: SA suspends store → device tokens NOT revoked. POS continues syncing, creating sales. Data integrity risk.

high_findings.title: Admin User Suspension Does Not Terminate Sessions
high_findings.description: SA suspends user → auth.users.status=suspended but refresh tokens not revoked. Redis sessions not cleared. Access continues for hours.

high_findings.title: Admin Deactivation Doesn't Clear Sessions
high_findings.description: SA deactivates admin → api_key_hash cleared but JWT sessions in Redis persist. Deactivated admin retains access.

high_findings.title: Supplier Suspension Doesn't Hide Products or Block Orders
high_findings.description: transitionSupplier() updates only status. No product disabling. No order blocking. Retailers can order from suspended suppliers.

high_findings.title: Application Approval Skips State Machine Transitions
high_findings.description: POST /applications/:id/approve creates store with status=ACTIVE directly. No DRAFT→ENROLLED→KYC→ACTIVE transition.

high_findings.title: Device Deactivation Has NO Notification to Device User
high_findings.description: SA deactivates device → no notification sent. Next POS sync fails silently.

high_findings.title: User/Staff Suspension Has NO Notification
high_findings.description: SA suspends user → no email/SMS. User discovers only on next login attempt (401).

high_findings.title: Application Rejection Only Updates DB — No Email to Applicant
high_findings.description: Unlike approval (which has notification), rejection endpoint has NO notification code.

high_findings.title: Refund Rejection Has NO Communication to Requester
high_findings.description: SA rejects refund → status changes silently. No notification to retailer/customer.

high_findings.title: Device Deactivation During Active Checkout Breaks Cart
high_findings.description: Staff mid-checkout → SA deactivates device → next API call fails 403. Cart locked. cancelSale() also requires active device. Must force-close app.

high_findings.title: Feature Flag Toggle During Active Sale Creation
high_findings.description: Flag checked at sale creation vs confirmation. If flag changes between, mismatch: sale created with CASH but CASH no longer allowed.

high_findings.title: Two Admins Conflicting Store Status Changes — No Optimistic Locking
high_findings.description: No ETag, version field, or FOR UPDATE on store status. Last-write-wins. Store ends in unexpected state.

root_causes: 60-second polling cadence too coarse for security events (suspension, deactivation, token reset)
Offline-first POS design assumes token validity without server re-check
Client-side caching of roles/permissions without TTL or invalidation
No push notification (SSE/WebSocket/FCM) for critical security changes from SA
Fallback to safe defaults on API errors masks revocation/deactivation
State machines (store/supplier) update only primary table — no cascade to related entities
No distributed transaction or saga pattern between admin actions and in-flight operations
Notification infrastructure exists (FCM, email, SMS, WhatsApp, SSE) but NOT wired to admin action routes
No optimistic locking (ETag/version) on shared resources — last-write-wins
30-second cache TTL on storeStatusGate.ts with no invalidation mechanism

notification_infrastructure_audit.NOT_used_for: Store suspension, supplier suspension, device deactivation, user suspension, refund processing, feature flag changes, token reset

polling_latency_by_client.retailer_portal: HTTP fetch on page visit only (no polling)
polling_latency_by_client.supplier_portal: EventSource exists but NOT hooked to admin events

implementation_priority_top_15.title: Store suspension must cascade to device tokens + sessions
Cache invalidation on store status change (storeStatusGate.ts)
Supplier suspension must hide products from catalogs
User suspension must revoke sessions + tokens immediately
Device token reset must force DeviceBlockedScreen navigation
Invoice void must check for in-flight payments (FOR UPDATE)
Staff role changes must be polled or pushed to POS
Wire notification service to store/supplier suspension flows
Staff deactivation must revoke POS sessions
Supplier portal must check verification_status on every API call
Add optimistic locking (version/ETag) to store status updates
Store deletion must cascade to devices + enrollment codes
Device deactivation during checkout must gracefully unlock cart
Application rejection must trigger notification to applicant
Retailer portal AuthContext must check store status
